text: The transformer architecture relies on self-attention to weigh token relationships in parallel, replacing recurrence. Multi-head attention lets the model attend to different representation subspaces, and positional encoding restores order information.

BM25 is a probabilistic ranking function used in information retrieval. It combines term frequency saturation with inverse document frequency and document length normalization to score how well a document matches a query.

Dense embeddings map text to continuous vectors so semantic similarity becomes vector distance. Embedding models are trained with contrastive objectives that pull related passages together and push unrelated ones apart.

Retrieval pipelines split long documents into chunks before indexing. Fixed token windows with overlap are simple and robust, while structure-aware splitting keeps paragraphs or sections intact. Chunk size trades recall against precision.

A cross-encoder reranker scores query-document pairs jointly and reorders the candidates returned by a fast first-stage retriever. Reranking improves precision at the top of the ranking at the cost of latency.
Hybrid search combines sparse lexical retrieval like BM25 with dense vector retrieval. Reciprocal rank fusion merges the ranked lists so a document strong in either signal surfaces near the top.

Retrieval quality is measured with recall at k, precision at k, mean reciprocal rank and normalized discounted cumulative gain. Graded relevance judgments, or qrels, let nDCG reward rankings that place highly relevant documents first.

Retrieval augmented generation grounds a language model on retrieved passages to reduce hallucination. The answer should cite the passages it relies on, and unsupported claims are flagged as unfaithful.
Gradient descent minimizes a loss function by stepping against the gradient. The learning rate controls the step size, and variants like momentum and Adam adapt the updates per parameter.
Sourdough bread rises with a wild yeast starter instead of commercial yeast. A long fermentation develops flavor, and bakers score the loaf before baking to control expansion in the oven.

Docker packages an application with its dependencies into a container image. Images are built in layers from a Dockerfile, and containers share the host kernel while isolating the filesystem and network.

Relevance judgments are usually collected by human annotators who read each candidate document and assign a grade. Binary judgments mark documents relevant or not, while graded scales capture degrees of relevance.
